_comment: Board pickups are a lounge hunt (Abe, playtest 2026-10-03): work out which regular has the item and push it out of them. Very dry humour; it's a board job. Written by Claude, large on purpose (Abe: a big authored pool beats a small one or a model's). {part} is the item's name (always 'the {part}' or 'it', never 'a {part}'); {holder} is the holder's first and last name. Every pool rotates: no line repeats until the whole pool has been used. Tells are stage directions in brackets and only the holder shows one; bystander lines never contain brackets.
deflect: I own a mug and a grudge. Neither is your {part}.
If I had it, I'd be using it. Look at me. I'm overheating emotionally.
No. But thank you for assuming I'm the sort of person who would.
I've been asked that twice today. You're the second most hopeful.
I don't carry anything I can't explain to customs. Which is nothing. I carry nothing.
My pockets contain lint, regret and a coupon that expired last cycle.
Do I look like someone with the {part}? Don't answer that.
I came here to drink, not to be useful.
No. I'm between possessions at the moment.
I sold everything interesting I owned in my twenties.
If I had the {part}, I'd have sold it to you already. At a markup.
I'm a simple person. I have a drink and a bad attitude. That's the inventory.
Not me. I'm the one who loses things, not the one who has them.
I wouldn't know the {part} if it bit me. Does it bite?
No, and I'm offended you didn't ask me something harder.
The only thing I'm holding is this table up.
I checked. Twice. Still just me in here.
Ask me about engine tolerances. Ask me about my divorce. Not that.
No. I deal in gossip, not hardware.
I'm on a strict no-mysterious-packages diet.
If it isn't in this glass, I don't have it.
Funny, I was about to ask you the same thing.
I had something like that once. It's a long story and it ends with a fine.
Not a chance. I travel light. Mostly because I keep getting robbed.
Sorry. I only collect bad decisions.
I don't even have a ship right now. I have a bar stool and ambition.
No. Try someone who looks like they have secrets. That's everyone except me.
I'm afraid I'm exactly as empty-handed as I look.
I've got a cough, a debt and a cousin in waste reclamation. That's it.
No. And whoever does probably won't say so either. Good luck.
If I had it, I'd have lost it by now. That's my whole thing.
I don't hold onto anything longer than a drink.
The {part}? Never touched one. Never wanted to. Never been asked until now.
You've mistaken me for someone with plans.
I'd help, but helping is outside my skill set.
Not mine. I don't keep things that need explaining.
I'm here to forget my day, not to improve yours.
I wish. I'd have something to talk about.
Check under the table. Not mine. Just a general tip for this place.
No. I only have what I came in with, and I'm leaving with less.
hint: Try {holder}. They've been guarding that bag like it pays rent.
{holder} came in with something warm under their coat. I didn't ask. You should.
Not me. {holder}, probably. They've been suspiciously calm.
Ask {holder}. Nobody sits that still unless they're hiding something.
{holder} hasn't let go of that satchel since they sat down. Even to drink.
I'd start with {holder}. They tipped the bartender. Nobody tips the bartender.
{holder} asked me if this place has lockers. Twice.
Have you tried {holder}? They keep checking the door like someone's coming for it.
{holder} has the look of someone carrying something they were told not to open.
Try {holder}. They flinched when you came in. I enjoyed it.
{holder}. Definitely {holder}. They ordered water. Who orders water here?
I saw {holder} sign for a sealed crate this morning. Make of that what you will.
{holder} has been humming. Badly. Like someone pretending to be relaxed.
Not me, but {holder} keeps patting their pocket like it might leave.
Talk to {holder}. They sat with their back to the wall. Amateurs.
{holder}'s been nursing one drink for an hour. That's not thirst, that's a stakeout.
Ask {holder}. They told me nothing so loudly it was basically a confession.
{holder} came in from the docks carrying something with a warning sticker.
Try {holder}. Their bag hummed earlier. They glared at it.
{holder} offered to buy me a drink if I stopped looking at their luggage.
I'd lean on {holder}. Gently. Or not. I'm not your conscience.
{holder}. They keep saying 'what package' before anyone mentions a package.
Look for {holder}. Nervous, overdressed, sitting on something. Literally sitting on it.
{holder} has been here since opening and hasn't once taken off that coat.
Try {holder}. They asked the bartender if anyone had been asking about anything.
{holder} paid in cash and asked for a receipt with no name on it.
I think {holder}'s your problem. They've been watching the dock board all night.
{holder}. I'd bet my drink on it, and I don't bet my drink lightly.
Ask {holder}. Ask them twice. They fold on the second ask, I've seen it.
{holder} told me they 'definitely weren't holding anything for anyone'. Unprompted.
deny: The {part}? What would I want with the... no. No idea what you mean.
Never heard of it. Lovely word, though.
I'm just here for the ambience. Which is mostly coolant fumes.
I don't know what you're talking about, and I'd like to keep it that way.
No. Absolutely not. Why, who's asking? No.
I'm a simple traveller with a simple bag containing simple things.
Package? I don't do packages. I do drinks. Watch.
Never seen it. Couldn't describe it. Wouldn't recognise it in a lineup.
You've got the wrong person. I've got the wrong drink. Let's both move on.
I'm not holding anything for anyone. That's a policy. I have policies.
The {part}? Sounds made up. Is it made up? I bet it's made up.
I came in here empty-handed and I'll leave empty-handed. Spiritually.
No idea. I've been sitting here the whole time. Not sitting on anything. Just sitting.
What a strange thing to ask a stranger. Good night.
Not me. I'm just a person in a coat. A normal coat. Normal weight.
I don't have it. I've never had it. I'd remember having it.
Me? I can barely hold my drink, let alone the {part}.
Look, if I had it, would I be sitting in this dump? Don't answer that either.
Sorry, I only speak in a language where that word doesn't exist.
I'm on holiday. Holidays don't come with sealed packages.
Wrong table, wrong question, wrong evening.
You must be thinking of someone much more interesting than me.
If I knew anything about it, I'd be legally obliged not to. So, no.
I keep my hands where I can see them, and they're empty. Mostly.
Haven't the faintest. I'm famously faint.
No. Next question. Ideally about the weather in here, which is warm. Unrelated.
I'm just here to wait for someone. Not for the {part}. For a person. A friend. Probably.
Never. I don't even like the sound of it.
I'm sure I'd love to help, if I knew what you meant, which I don't.
tell: (Their hand drifts to the bag under the table.)
(They don't look at you. They look at their coat pocket.)
(The pause before that was slightly too long.)
(Something under their coat makes a small, guilty hum.)
(They nudge a bag further under the table with one boot.)
(They answered before you'd finished the question.)
(Their eyes flick to the door, then to their lap.)
(They're sweating. It isn't that warm in here.)
(They pull their coat tighter. It clunks.)
(They laugh a little too loudly at nothing.)
(A corner of a sealed crate is poking out from behind their stool.)
(They've suddenly found their drink very interesting.)
(They glance at the bartender as if for help. The bartender declines.)
(Their knee is bouncing hard enough to rattle the table.)
(They rest a protective hand on the seat beside them. Nobody is sitting there.)
(The bag at their feet has a warning sticker. They put a napkin over it.)
(They clear their throat. Twice. Then a third time, for emphasis.)
(They check their pocket, then pretend they were checking the time.)
(A faint smell of hot metal drifts from their direction.)
(They smile at you. It's a terrible smile.)
(They slide a sealed case off the table and onto their lap. Smoothly. Almost.)
(They say 'no' while very slowly nodding.)
(They suddenly have an urgent need to look at the ceiling.)
(Their hand hasn't left their bag strap once.)
(They tuck a manifest tag back into their sleeve.)
(The thing under their coat beeps. They cough over it.)
(They move their drink to cover something on the table.)
(They've gone very still, the way animals do.)
(They glance down at their feet, where a box very carefully isn't.)
(They lean back, casual, and nearly fall off the stool.)
hedge: Say I had it. Hypothetically. It would be very sealed and very unsniffed.
You're persistent. That's either a virtue or a symptom.
Let's say, for argument's sake, that I know a person. Who is me.
If I did have it, which I'm not saying, it wouldn't be cheap to let go of.
Who sent you? No, don't tell me. I can guess. I hate that I can guess.
Supposing it existed, and supposing it was in this bag. Purely as a thought experiment.
You keep asking like you already know. That's very rude.
I was told to hand it to someone who asked. I wasn't told they'd be you.
Fine. I may have seen it. Up close. For several hours.
Look, it's been a long day and this thing has been humming for most of it.
Okay. Maybe. But I want it on record that I resisted.
I'm not saying yes. I'm saying no less firmly than before.
You're not going to go away, are you. No. You have that face.
There might be something. In this bag. That I might be holding. Against my will.
How do I know you're the one who's supposed to get it? You do have the look.
I'd hand it over, but then I'd have nothing to hold on to. Emotionally.
All right, I know of it. In the way one knows of a rash.
Ask me once more and I might crack. I'm warning you, I'm close.
Theoretically, if you were the person on the job board, I might have something.
I've been sitting on it so long it feels like family. Annoying family.
It's not that I don't want to give it to you. It's that I'm enjoying this.
Maybe I've got it. Maybe I've been waiting for someone who'd actually ask twice.
If you buy me another drink, I'll consider telling you what you already know.
You know how hard it is to keep a secret in a place like this? Very. As it turns out.
I was hoping someone more polite would come. But you'll do. Almost.
give: Fine. Take it. It hums when it's lonely. That's normal. Probably.
It's yours. Don't open it, don't sniff it, don't name it. I did all three.
Here. Tell whoever posted that job they owe me a drink. You can be the drink.
All right, all right. Here. It's heavier than it looks and it looks very heavy.
Take it before I change my mind. I've changed it four times already.
Here's your {part}. It's been a pleasure. It hasn't.
Fine. It's yours. If it starts ticking, it was always like that.
You win. Here. Mind the sticker. Don't read the sticker.
Take it. I've been carrying it so long I'd started talking to it.
Here. And for the record, I never had it, and you never got it from me.
You've worn me down. Congratulations. Here's your reward. It's warm.
Go on, then. It's sealed, it's grumpy, and it's your problem now.
Fine. Here. Please stop looking at me like I'm the last cake on the plate.
Here's the {part}. Hold it level. Don't ask why. I didn't.
Take it. My shoulder will thank you. My conscience will be fine either way.
Very well. Handle with care, or don't. It's not my contract any more.
Here. Tell nobody it was me. Tell them it was a very persuasive stranger.
There. It's yours. I feel lighter. Literally. That thing weighs a ton.
Fine, take it. You'd make a good debt collector. That's not a compliment.
Here. If anyone asks, it was like this when I found it.
Take it and go, before someone asks me to hold something else.
All yours. Don't drop it. Last person who dropped one isn't around to tell you why.
Oh, fine. Here. You've ruined my evening and saved my back.
Here it is. It's never been opened, and you'll want to keep it that way.
Fine. Have it. I'm going to sit here and enjoy having two free hands.
There you go. And remember: I was difficult. Put that in the report.
Take it. I hope you get paid more than I did, which was nothing.
Here. Quick, before it starts humming again. It does that when it's watched.
You've earned it. Mostly through attrition, but still.
Fine. Here. Don't come back asking me to hold anything else. Ever.
